name: join-page-offset
description: Compare deterministic JOIN pagination with different OFFSET boundaries

queries.name: first-page
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0

queries.name: mid-page
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 30

queries.name: short-page
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id, a.tier FROM events e JOIN accounts a ON e.user_id = a.user_id ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT 5 OFFSET 60
